title: just ok
text: just ok. I like the idea of these hangers but they are just ok. They're way bigger than I was picturing them, very wide, and they don't actually save that much space once you have several pairs of pants on them. Using them is kind of frustrating too, I would say that these are better for maybe storing off season clothes long term than actually using them daily.
